submission_format: A single Python module named solution.py

evaluation.pass_rule: All correctness tests pass and the weighted score is at least 0.7

title: Python Fundamentals
summary: Build a tiny text-analytics toolkit: word counts, top-k ranking and min-max normalisation.
requirements: word_frequencies(text) counts lowercase words; any non-letter character separates words
top_k(freqs, k) returns (word, count) pairs sorted by count descending, ties alphabetically
normalize(values) rescales numbers to [0, 1]; a constant list maps to all 0.0; an empty list returns []
description: Every data pipeline starts with small, reliable functions. Implement the three functions in `solution.py`. Hidden tests check correctness, edge cases (empty input, punctuation, ties) and performance on a large text.
